sections.h2: Riverwalk Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 186 residential sales closed in Riverwalk (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $281,750, below the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 18 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Riverwalk sales closed between $235,500 and $439,750, or about $203 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($288,450, 94 sales) was about 4% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($277,500, 92 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Riverwalk sales were in ZIP code 23320.

28% of sales here were detached homes, versus 76% citywide. 21% of Riverwalk sales had four or more bedrooms, against 53% citywide. 0% of the homes sold here were built in 2015 or later; across Chesapeake the figure is 24%.

sections.h2: When Riverwalk Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Riverwalk were busiest in May (20 sales across the two years) and slowest in December (10 sales). Sold prices ran from $162,500 to $799,000, a spread of 4.9x between the lowest and highest sale. 74% of homes closed at or above list price and 5% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Riverwalk
sections.html:
28% of the sales were detached homes and 72% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,523 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,179 to 2,094 square feet. 53% of the homes that sold had 2 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1989 and 1998, with a median year built of 1993, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
